title: AI-Driven Optimization of Clinical Trial Preparation: From Protocol Design to CRO Selection
summary: MEDIAIPLUS reports 85% less trial-data alignment time, 10% lower outsourcing costs, and a 25% improvement in trial success across early deployments.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: MEDIAIPLUS describes AI tools for protocol preparation and matching sponsors with research organizations. Early deployments reportedly reduced data-alignment time by 85% and outsourcing costs by 10%, while improving trial success by 25%. Blisstech is named as a validation partner. The submission does not give trial counts, comparison periods, or a patient benefit attributable to the tools.
purpose: Streamline protocol planning and selection of clinical research partners.

ratings.reason: MEDIAIPLUS reports 25% better trial success, 85% less data-alignment time, and 10% lower outsourcing costs across early deployments. Measurement details are unavailable.
Faster access to therapy is inferred from trial preparation, not documented for a patient.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 13: AI-Driven Optimization of Clinical Trial Preparation: From Protocol Design to CRO Selection

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: MediC and FiCRO report faster clinical-trial preparation
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
